pce.description:
This is the device efficiency in %. Make sure to convert it to a percentage if it's given as a fraction before reporting.
Sometimes several different PCE values are presented for the same device. It could be a stabilized efficiency, a value extracted from a reversed JV scan, a value extracted from a forward JV scan. Only state one value. If several values are present for the device The priority is: Stabilized values is preferred before JV data from the reverse scan which is preferred before JV values from the forward scan.

ff.description: This field requires the fill factor as a percentage without the % sign. If the fill factor is given as a fraction, e.g. 0.2, convert it to and write it as 20 without any percentage sign (%).

active_area.description: Reported active area of the solar cell.

number_devices.description: Number of devices over which the metrics have been averaged

averaged_quantities.description: True if metrics are averaged over multiple devices

encapsulated.description: True if the device is encapsulated

layer_order.description: Order of the layers in the device stack. Use the layer names as they appear in the "Layers" section, separated by "|". If you want to add a missing layer, please add it first to the Layers section below. Then make sure to add the name of the layer, as you list it below, in this field in the right order. When you hit save on the top right, the correct order will be set on the layers in the Layers section below.

classic_entry.description: This is the classic schema entry that is generated from this LLM extracted entry. It is generated when the entry is normalized and saved and does not need to be filled.

name.description: A short name for the substance.

molecular_mass.description:
The mass of the most likely isotopic composition for a single molecule,
corresponding to the most intense ion/molecule peak in a mass spectrum.

molar_mass.description:
The molar mass is the sum of all atomic masses of the constituent atoms in a
compound, measured in g/mol. In the absence of explicit isotope labelling,
averaged natural abundance is assumed. If an atom bears an explicit isotope label,
100%% isotopic purity is assumed at this location.

monoisotopic_mass.description:
The mass of a molecule, calculated using the mass of the most abundant isotope of
each element.

dimensionality.description: The dimensionality of the perovskite, i.e. 3D, 2D, 1D (nanorods), quantum dots (0D), etc.

band_gap.description: Band gap of photoabsorber in eV.

description.description: Additional details about the light source. This is very important.

lamp.description: Type of lamp used to generate the spectrum

humidity.description: The ambient humidity as a percentage without the % sign (i.e. a value between 0 and 100). When measurements are done in an inert atmosphere, this should be 0. If the humidity is fluctuating, use the average value.

PCE_T80.description: The time after which the cell performance has degraded by 20% with respect to the initial performance.

PCE_at_start.description: PCE at the start of the experiment as a percentage without the % sign.

PCE_after_1000_hours.description: PCE after 1000 hours as a percentage without the % sign.

PCE_at_end.description: PCE at the end of the experiment as a percentage without the % sign.

volume_fraction.description: The volume fraction of the solvent with respect to the other solvents in the solution

volume.description: This volume is the volume of solution used in the experiment, e.g. the solvent volume that is spin-coated rather than the volume of the stock solution.

method.description: This is the method for the processing of steps in the design of the cells. Some examples are: Spin-coating, Drop-infiltration, Evaporation, Co-evaporation, Doctor blading, Spray coating, Slot-die coating, Ultrasonic spray, Dropcasting, Inkjet printing, Electrospraying, Thermal-annealing, Antisolvent-quenching

temperature.description: The temperature during the deposition step. Depending on the circumstances the most relevant temperature could be either the ambient temperature, the substrate temperature, or the solution temperature.

antisolvent.description: Any antisolvent(s) used in the processing step. Separate multiple antisolvents with a semicolon (;).

additional_parameters.description: Any additional parameters specific to this processing step

additional_treatment.description:
Description of modifications applied to this layer beyond its basic composition, including:

- Self-assembled monolayers (SAMs)
- Surface passivation treatments
- Interface engineering (e.g., Lewis base/acid treatments)
- Additives or dopants
- Post-deposition treatments

Use established terminology: "SAM" for self-organized molecular layers, "surface passivation", "doping" where applicable.

git_commit.description: Link to git commit of the extraction code

model_version.description: Version of the model used for extraction
